content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I hope you are having a great week. I am looking forward to getting started, but I would like to propose a few small adjustments to the agreement before I sign.

- Regarding the clause stating: "Consultant also agrees to promptly make full written disclosure to the Company of any Inventions and to deliver and assign (or cause to be assigned) and irrevocably assigns fully to the Company all right, title and interest in and to the Inventions." This currently requires assigning intellectual property rights immediately upon creation without making the transfer conditional on receiving full payment. Please update this to: "Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in and to the Inventions."

Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can move forward.

Best regards,
